offering_description.value: Owns hotel properties, mainly upscale select-service hotels in the US, and leases them to taxable REIT subsidiaries. Hotels operate under franchise brands and are run by third-party management companies, serving business and leisure travelers.

primary_services.value: hotel lodging; hotel property ownership and leasing

customer_segment.value: B2C: leisure travelers staying at owned hotels; B2B: business travelers, corporate accounts and groups

end_markets.value: hospitality; lodging; business and leisure travel

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: room revenue from guest stays at owned hotels; service fees: food and beverage and other hotel ancillary revenue

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns upscale select-service hotels, run by third-party managers under franchise brands, sold to travelers

geography_served.value: US national: hotels in many US states, concentrated in Sun Belt and urban markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: upscale select-service hotel ownership

distribution_channels.value: own locations: owned hotels operated under franchise brands by management companies; online: brand websites and online travel agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: REIT tax rules (IRS), plus hotel safety, health, and ADA requirements and local licensing

notes: Based on general knowledge; current portfolio size may have changed.
